guardrails: V18 exploration identity must survive routing -> dispatch -> activation -> claim -> search run.
Work-steal preserves original exploration identity for audit but is excluded from matched worker-effect analysis.
Manual overrides and unrouted runs are excluded from matched exploration analysis.
A V18 pair is analysis-ready only after two distinct primary generated runs complete with matched telemetry.
V19 establishes provenance eligibility only; it does not estimate worker effects or causal outcomes.
